fine_trace.note: The attacker-controlled decimal precision in the format string is parsed into the local int precision variable prec.
get_num bounds next_n against MRB_INT_MAX but stores it through an int pointer, so a value greater than INT_MAX wraps to a negative prec instead of being rejected.
The negative precision passes the precision truncation condition for a non-empty string.
The wrapped negative precision is added to the argument string pointer, producing a pointer before the start of the string.
The out-of-bounds pointer difference is stored as a negative length for the copy that will append the string to the result.
PUSH passes the negative len to memcpy via its length argument, triggering the sanitizer negative-size-param memory-safety sink.
